rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.managePhotos: Manage photos in the media library
rooms.archiveHint: Archived rooms are not sold and don't appear on the website. Existing bookings stay.
rooms.deleteConfirm: Delete permanently? This can't be undone.
rooms.archiveConfirm: Archive? It will no longer be sold.

f.name: Name
f.slugHint: Used in the room's link. Leave empty to create it from the English name.
f.baseOccupancyHint: Extra adults / children above this pay the child & extra-bed prices.
f.basePriceHint: Used outside seasons. Seasons and the rate calendar can change it per date.

rates.title: Rate calendar
rates.hint: Click a date or drag across dates (and rows) to select. On a phone: tap the first and the last date. Then choose what to change, preview, and apply. Changes affect new bookings only — confirmed bookings keep their price.
rates.noSelection: Nothing selected yet — select dates in the grid or fill in the form.

ops.clear: Remove changes (back to season / base price)

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.hint: A season sets the nightly price per room type for a date range. Leave a price empty to use the room type's base price. Changes apply only to new bookings.
seasons.name: Season name
seasons.emptyHint: Empty price = base price of the room type. Specific dates can still be changed in the rate calendar.
seasons.overlap: Some seasons overlap. Where they overlap, the season that starts later wins — please check:
seasons.deleteConfirm: Delete this season? Its prices will no longer apply to new bookings.

extras.title: Extras & children
extras.extrasHint: Services guests can add while booking (breakfast, transfer, …). Hidden extras are not offered.
extras.name: Name
extras.guestsHint: Guests above the room's included number pay extra per night. Children are priced by age band; an extra adult and an extra bed are priced separately. Price can be fixed (GEL per night) or a % of that night's room price.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.hint: Discount codes guests enter at checkout. Usage and revenue count confirmed, stayed and no-show bookings. Changes apply to new bookings only.
promos.allTypesHint: None ticked = valid for all room types.

media.title: Media library
media.summary: {used} of {total} photos are in use · {demo} of them are DEMO photos
media.drop: Drop photos here or click to choose
media.dropHint: Many files at once · JPG, PNG, HEIC, WebP · converted to WebP + AVIF automatically, location data removed
media.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}}
media.duplicates: {count, plural, one {# photo was already in the library} other {# photos were already in the library}} — reused
media.demoBadge: DEMO image – replace with real hotel photo
media.altHint: Describes the photo for Google and blind visitors, e.g. “Sea-view balcony at sunset”.
media.replaceHint: Upload a new file — it replaces this photo everywhere it is used.
media.deleteUsed: This photo is used in: {places}. Deleting removes it from all these places. Delete anyway?
media.noRoomPhotos: This room type has no photos yet — the website shows a plain colour instead.
media.galleryHint: Drag photos to change their order inside each gallery category. To add or remove a photo, open it under “All photos” and switch “Show in the website gallery”.

slot.heroHint: Large landscape photo at the top of the home page (min. 2000 px wide).
slot.heroMobileHint: Portrait photo shown on phones. Empty = the desktop photo is cropped.
slot.ctaHint: Background of the “Book your stay” band near the end of the home page.
slot.ogHint: Shown when a link to the site is shared on Facebook, WhatsApp, Viber… Empty = the hero photo.

auth.forgotIntro: Enter your work e-mail. If it belongs to an active staff account, we'll send a link to set a new password.
auth.passwordRules: At least 10 characters, with letters and at least one digit.

err.locked: Too many wrong passwords — this account is locked for 15 minutes. The owner can unlock it sooner.
err.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.

msg.reset_requested: If this e-mail belongs to a staff account, a link is on its way. It is valid for 60 minutes.
msg.password_set: Your new password is saved. You can sign in now.

mail.resetSubject: Royale Hotel admin — set a new password
mail.resetIntro: Someone (hopefully you) asked to reset the password of your Royale Hotel admin account. Click the button to choose a new one.
mail.inviteIntro: An account was created for you in the Royale Hotel admin panel. Click the button to choose your password.
mail.expires: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
mail.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, ignore this e-mail — your password stays the same.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Name
staff.inviteHint: Off = a temporary password is shown here once instead.
staff.tempConfirm: Set a new temporary password? Their current password stops working and they are signed out.
staff.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this account? The person is signed out at once and can't sign in. Their history stays.

roleInfo.OWNER: everything, including staff accounts and settings.
roleInfo.MANAGER: everything except staff accounts and settings.
roleInfo.RECEPTION: dashboard, bookings, calendar, guests and the housekeeping view — no prices, reports or settings.

account.title: My account
account.languageHint: The language of the admin panel for you only.

settings.title: Settings

sh.hotel: Name, address and practical facts shown on the website and in e-mails.
sh.contact: Shown in the header, footer, contact page, e-mails and the WhatsApp / Viber / Telegram buttons. Empty fields are hidden.
sh.booking: Apply to new bookings only. Existing bookings keep the rules they were made with.
sh.payments: Which ways to pay the guest can choose at checkout.
sh.notifications: Who is told about new bookings, cancellations and channel conflicts.
sh.trust: Only show a rating that matches your real Google reviews.
sh.currency: Prices are kept in GEL. Guests can switch the display to USD / EUR using these rates.

f.name: Hotel name
f.cityTaxPerPersonNight: City tax per adult per night (GEL)

h.telegramChatId: Add the hotel's bot to the staff group, then paste the group's chat id (see README)
h.paymentProvider: “Test mode” takes no real money — switch to TBC or Bank of Georgia once the merchant account is ready
h.lat: From Google Maps: right-click the hotel → the first number

settings.autoUpdate: Update automatically every day from the National Bank of Georgia
settings.autoUpdateHint: Official rate; your manual rate is overwritten once a day.
settings.updateNow: Update now from the National Bank

ch.title: Channel sync (iCal)
ch.intro: For each room type, give Booking.com / Airbnb the export link (their calendar closes when the room type is sold out here), and paste their import link below (their reservations then block a room here). Links sync automatically every 15 minutes. iCal carries only dates — prices and guest details still come from each channel.
